# Reusable SFX library (44.1 kHz, 16-bit mono WAV, generated by make_sfx.py, no copyright issues)

| file | length | use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| typing.wav | 1.6 s | code being typed (trim with data-duration to the line's length) |
| enter.wav | 0.18 s | pressing Enter / running the script |
| whoosh.wav | 0.55 s | titles, scenes and cards sliding in |
| swap.wav | 0.32 s | items moving or trading places |
| pop.wav | 0.16 s | an object appearing |
| tick.wav | 0.05 s | small staggered items, terminal output |
| ding.wav | 0.9 s | success / highlight / call to action |
| thud.wav | 0.35 s | something removed or an error |

Use in any HyperFrames project: copy this folder into assets/, then
`<audio id="x1" class="clip" src="assets/sfx/whoosh.wav" data-start="2.0" data-duration="0.55" data-volume="0.4" data-track-index="11"></audio>`
Regenerate or tweak: `python3 make_sfx.py [out_dir]`.
